```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

The simulation API separates the data-generating process, covariate design,
and sample structure. Conditional simulation fixes a known parameter truth and
is appropriate for parameter-recovery experiments.

```{r}
library(VariationalBayesHLRM)

simulation <- simulate_data(
  generator = conditional_dgp(
    lrm_model(2),
    list(coefficients = c(1, 2), residual_variance = 0.5)
  ),
  design = simulation_design(
    distribution = "grid",
    bounds = matrix(c(-2, 2), nrow = 1)
  ),
  sample = simulation_sample(sample_size = 40),
  seed = 201
)

truth <- tidy_truth(simulation)
truth
plot(simulation)

prior <- lrm_prior(c(0, 0), 10 * diag(2), 4, 1)
fit <- fit_model(
  lrm_model(2), simulation$train, prior, "cavi",
  initialization_ols(), cavi_control(max_iterations = 300),
  seed = 202, verbose = FALSE
)

tidy_parameters(fit)
plot(fit, type = "coefficients")
```

`hierarchical_dgp()` redraws local or component parameters from population
truth for HLRM and CHLRM. `prior_predictive_dgp()` redraws the complete
parameter hierarchy from the same prior object used for fitting and supports
simulation-based calibration. These modes answer different questions and
their recovery metrics must not be pooled.
